verdict.rationale: Elicit's first-party docs cover the whole story: team members can be invited to collaborate live in Research Agent sessions, and collaborators with edit access can ask the agent questions, produce new artifacts and edit existing ones. Workflows can be shared via an "Anyone with the link can view" link that works without an Elicit account, shared items arrive in Recents, and Collections can be shared with colleagues. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the sharing and collaboration features work as documented.
